theorems.name: Submission.dor_stationary_cycle_epsilon_regularity
theorems.statement: ∀ (n k ℓ : ℕ), ℓ ≤ k → 0 < n → ∀ (U N : Set (Euclid (n + k))) (y₀ : Euclid (n + k)), IsOpen U → IsEmbeddedSubmanifold 2 (n + ℓ) N → (closure N \ N) ∩ U = ∅ → y₀ ∈ N ∩ U → ∃ r₀ δ : ℝ, 0 < r₀ ∧ 0 < δ ∧ ∀ (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (R : IMRep U n), R.Represents T → T.support ⊆ N → BoundaryVanishes T → R.IsStationaryAlong N → ∀ z ∈ T.support, dist z y₀ < r₀ → ∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → ρ ≤ r₀ → T.massOn (ball z ρ) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (1 + δ) * unitBallVolume n * ENNReal.ofReal (ρ ^ n) → z ∈ regularSet T
